finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Sure, but don’t try to infuse energy or anything. It can get a bit fussy if people do that,” Jake warned her.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “But if you want to see it, sure,” Jake said as he waved his hand and summoned his Apex Hunter’s bow. Keerla’s gaze was laser-focused on it from the moment it was summoned, her eyes wide.
